text:
Type: woven seagrass belly basket
Use: storing throws or toys, covering a plant pot; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: bohemian, coastal, Scandinavian
Materials: hand-woven natural seagrass, braided handles
Colors: warm natural straw, light honey beige
Shape: round bulging belly that narrows to a smaller opening, herringbone weave, two loop handles, soft flexible sides, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, relaxed, warm
Goes with: green plants, linen, rattan, light wood, white walls; bohemian, coastal or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: FLDIS
product.description: You can choose how you want to use this basket  turned up with handles or turned down to display the contents.
